changelog:
Fixed stale player actions so hidden, detached or rebuilt controls cannot act on another player.
Bound frame capture and cancellation to the initiating action; obsolete callbacks cannot cancel a newer capture.
Fixed retained subtitle-font clicks, late root calls and old preference events; preserved native font size and embedded flags.
Kept native system bars untouched with no explicit opt-in; restored host state on final opt-out and retained status-bar transparency.
Updated the open Appearance page when scheduled themes change, with exact lifecycle observer cleanup.
Preserved PIN, capability and default-OFF gates, compact host styling, supported controls and saved choices.
Automated tests verify off-device contracts, not physical capture, decoder playback, Android TV or installed-host visuals.
message: harden player action ownership, subtitle callbacks and system bars renewed
